eaststreet_day: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original production background for a Chinese anime tactical RPG, landscape 3:2, preferably 1536x1024. Eye-level establishing view of an inhabited old clinic courtyard on Sunspire's east street, a warm sandstone river town rebuilt among the remains of a magical disaster seventeen years ago. It is late afternoon. Cream plaster, exposed warm timber, muted teal roof tiles, a few cracked old stone arches with repaired homes fitted between them. The courtyard opens from a narrow street; an ordinary wide timber doorway into former clinic rooms, visible practical door hinges, folded quilts, tied bundles, a simple empty wooden bedframe waiting to be carried, a low wash basin, a bucket, a small terracotta herb pot. At one side a modest open wooden boat-repair shed holds one small unfinished river skiff on timber rollers; keep the skiff out of the pedestrian path. A narrow covered water channel runs along the street edge with removable stone slabs, no flooding. The far skyline has a single broken pale tower silhouette, small and distant. The place feels still lived in and maintained, not an abandoned dungeon. No people, no statues of people. Visual direction: original Japanese hand-drawn anime background, precise dark warm linework, clear large color shapes, restrained two-step cel shadows, bright sky blue and turquoise against sandstone gold, soft cream plaster; readable architecture and material grouping, restrained fine texture. No photorealism, no 3D render, no painterly medieval grimdark, no excessive rubble or ornamental architecture. Camera at an adult's eye height, natural perspective, useful open foreground for character overlays; main architecture and important props in middle/upper two thirds because a dialogue box covers the lower part. No text, letters, numbers, UI, borders, labels, logos or watermark. Full opaque scene, not a map and not isometric.
